title: AgentRegistry
description: The ingest agent registry document (config/agents.v2.json, HAMMERTIME_INGEST_AGENTS_PATH). Spec section 36, ADR-0006. Holds keyed hashes of agent bearer tokens, never the tokens themselves. Version 2 is the first version with a schema; version 1 was the plaintext-token format this replaces.

registry_version.description: Format version of this document. A v1 (plaintext-token) registry has no such field and is rejected at load with a pointer to `hammertime-agent-token migrate`.

hash_algorithm.description: How token_hash was derived: HMAC-SHA-256 over the utf-8 token, keyed by the deployment secret in HAMMERTIME_INGEST_AGENT_TOKEN_KEY (base64url, >= 32 bytes decoded). A slow KDF is deliberately not used: agent tokens are 256-bit CSPRNG values and this hash is computed on every authenticated request (ADR-0006).

key_id.description: Fingerprint of the key the hashes below were computed with: the first 16 hex characters of HMAC-SHA-256(key, "hammertime-agent-token-key-id"). Ingest recomputes this at startup and refuses to start on a mismatch, so a wrong HAMMERTIME_INGEST_AGENT_TOKEN_KEY fails loudly instead of 403-ing every agent.

agents.description: Registered agents, keyed by agent_id. May be empty; the deployment key is still required.

agent_id.description: The identity an agent presents in X-Agent-Id, and the identity used for dedup (section 23), rate limiting, and event attribution (ADR-0004). Stable across credential rotation.

token_hash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte HMAC-SHA-256 digest of the agent's bearer token. Tools emit lowercase; either case is accepted, since the loader compares decoded bytes.

Hash of the agent's current bearer token. No two agents may share a hash (current or previous): one credential authenticating as several identities would defeat the per-agent dedup and rate-limit boundaries, and the loader rejects it.

previous_token_hash.description: Optional. Hash of the immediately previous token, accepted alongside token_hash for the duration of a rotation overlap window. At most one predecessor: an unbounded list would let a registry accumulate forgotten live credentials. Requires previous_token_expires_at, and must differ from token_hash.

previous_token_expires_at.description: Required whenever previous_token_hash is present (and forbidden otherwise). RFC 3339 UTC instant after which the previous token stops being accepted; ingest evaluates it per request, so the overlap window closes without a second restart. An already-past value is not a startup error: the loader drops the previous hash and warns.

enabled.description: Default true. A disabled agent is known but never authorized (spec section 36); disabling is how an agent is blocked, rather than deleting its entry or zeroing its rate limit.

rate_limit_rps.description: Per-agent override for HAMMERTIME_INGEST_RATE_LIMIT_RPS. null (the default) means use the global setting. Must be positive: there is no rate-limited-to-zero concept, use "enabled": false.
